scope_notice: Manifest records every other packaged file; this manifest cannot contain its own final byte hash. All historical originals outside this package left unchanged. Root-added official narration and API/delivery documents have their own media/provenance binding; they are outside this subpackage manifest until integrated by the root handoff.

policy.metadata: Explicit top-level and typed record whitelist; prompt, referenced_image_paths and transparent_background only for generation arguments.
excluded: full movie binaries and alternate/intermediate audio; current official narration is managed separately by root handoff
policy.portable_paths: All emitted asset/document paths repository-relative. Original source collections identified by non-secret relative labels and original SHA256.
